mapper.sql: select sc.score_id, sc.task_id, sc.course_id, sc.user_id, sc.group_id, sc.task_score, sc.group_adjust, sc.final_score, sc.level_code, sc.status, sc.publish_time, u.nick_name as student_name, p.student_no, tk.title as task_title, c.course_name, g.group_name, tk.total_score as total_score_full, tk.score_mode from edu_score sc left join sys_user u on u.user_id = sc.user_id left join edu_user_profile p on p.user_id = sc.user_id left join edu_task tk on tk.task_id = sc.task_id left join edu_course c on c.course_id = sc.course_id left join edu_group g on g.group_id = sc.group_id
mapper.insert: insert into edu_score (task_id, course_id, user_id, group_id, task_score, group_adjust, final_score, level_code, status, publish_time, create_time) values (#{taskId}, #{courseId}, #{userId}, #{groupId}, #{taskScore}, #{groupAdjust}, #{finalScore}, #{levelCode}, #{status}, #{publishTime}, sysdate())
insert into edu_score_adjust (score_id, old_score, new_score, reason, operator_id, operate_time, notify_flag) values (#{scoreId}, #{oldScore}, #{newScore}, #{reason}, #{operatorId}, sysdate(), '1')
mapper.select: select a.id, a.old_score as oldScore, a.new_score as newScore, a.reason, a.operate_time as operateTime, u.nick_name as operatorName from edu_score_adjust a left join sys_user u on u.user_id = a.operator_id where a.score_id = #{scoreId} order by a.id desc
select level_code from edu_grade_level where is_default = '1' and #{score} between min_score and max_score order by sort_no limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into edu_course_score (course_id, user_id, total_score, level_code, status, calc_time) values (#{courseId}, #{userId}, #{totalScore}, #{levelCode}, #{status}, sysdate()) on duplicate key update total_score = values(total_score), level_code = values(level_code), status = values(status), calc_time = sysdate()
mapper.select: select cs.user_id as userId, u.nick_name as studentName, p.student_no as studentNo, cs.total_score as totalScore, cs.level_code as levelCode, cs.status, cs.calc_time as calcTime from edu_course_score cs left join sys_user u on u.user_id = cs.user_id left join edu_user_profile p on p.user_id = cs.user_id where cs.course_id = #{courseId} and cs.user_id = #{userId} order by p.student_no

select count(1) as taskCount, round(avg(sc.final_score), 2) as avgScore, round(sum(sc.final_score), 2) as sumScore from edu_score sc where sc.course_id = #{courseId} and sc.user_id = #{userId} and sc.status in (1, 2)

select s.submission_id as submissionId, s.user_id as userId, s.group_id as groupId, r.review_id as reviewId, r.total_score as totalScore from edu_submission s join edu_review r on r.submission_id = s.submission_id and r.submission_version = s.version and r.status = 1 and r.is_return = '0' where s.task_id = #{taskId} and s.status = 3 order by s.user_id
